title: Independence Day Statutory Gram Sabha
agendaItems: Reading and confirmation of previous Gram Sabha minutes dated 1 May 2026
Presentation of Financial Year 2026–27 income & expenditure statement up to July 2026
Review of physical progress of Ward 2 CC Road and Jal Jeevan Mission pipeline works
Approval of PMAY-G Phase III priority beneficiary list after social audit
Sanction for replacement of 85 street lights with energy-saving LED fixtures
Swachh Bharat Mission plastic waste prohibition and household dustbin distribution
Open house citizen grievances regarding agricultural approach roads and water pressure
resolutionsSummary: Resolution #01: Unanimously confirmed proceedings of Maharashtra Din Gram Sabha.
Resolution #02: Approved ₹4,10,000 running expenditure for Ward 2 CC Road.
Resolution #03: Certified 100% completion of Jal Jeevan Mission pipeline extension in Wards 3 & 5.
Resolution #04: Finalized 18 eligible households for PMAY-G housing grant.
Resolution #05: Approved 5% rebate on House Tax paid before 15 October 2026.

title: Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti Special Gram Sabha

Review of Ward 1 & Ward 4 underground RCC drainage engineering plan
Reading of pending Namuna No. 8 property mutation applications
Discussion on winter drinking water storage and borewell maintenance
resolutionsSummary: Meeting scheduled for 2 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.

title: August Monthly Panchayat Committee Meeting
agendaItems: Verification of monthly cash book and bank reconciliation for July 2026
Scrutiny of vendor bills for street light repairs and waste collection

resolutionsSummary: Approved disbursement of ₹42,500 to Shree Ganesh Electricals (Bill BL-2026-041).
Approved disbursement of ₹56,000 to Green India Services for July sanitation.
Directed Account Clerk to issue House Tax reminder notices across all 6 wards.

Scheduled Overhead ESR Tank cleaning for 29 September 2026.
